body:
Quick mode — no voting panel. Rounds 1-3: 5 Cursor specialists in parallel + generic Codex. Main agent reviewed findings across round 1.

Round 1: 5 Cursor specialists + generic Codex. All findings rejected (pre-existing branch artifacts and trivial nits). No accepted findings → converged after round 1.

## Rejected Code Review Findings

### [Code Review] Cursor-Correctness (round 1)
**Finding**: Branch diff touches files beyond ship-pr.sh/test-ship-pr.sh/ship-pr.md.
**Reason not implemented**: Pre-existing commits from earlier branch runs, not the feature commit. Not a correctness issue.

### [Code Review] Cursor-Correctness (round 1)
**Finding**: Test uses wc -c (bytes) while plan says "2048 characters".
**Reason not implemented**: Trivial nit; ASCII content makes byte==character. Non-impactful.

### [Code Review] Cursor-Correctness (round 1)
**Finding**: Stdout cap only tested for checks phase.
**Reason not implemented**: Latent observation; checks phase is highest-volume. Adequate smoke test.

### [Code Review] Generic-Codex (round 1)
**Finding**: Various findings about SKILL.md breadcrumb directives.
**Reason not implemented**: All about files unrelated to the ship-pr fix. Out of scope.
